item.title: B.C. and Cowichan chiefs start negotiations after landmark court ruling on title
item.description: The B.C. government and chiefs from the Cowichan Nation say they've begun negotiations after a landmark court ruling.

item.title: Langley Township fire crews responding to structure fire
item.description: A structure fire has broken out near the intersection of 202 Street and 72 Avenue in Langley Township, the fire department said Monday afternoon.

item.title: B.C. Mountie gets probation in fatal 2017 arrest of Dale Culver in Prince George
item.description: A Mountie convicted of obstruction of justice in the 2017 death of an Indigenous man while in custody has been handed 18 months probation by a B.C. court.

item.title: Langley police stop speeding driver at 140 km/h
item.description: The Langley RCMP says it has stopped a driver travelling westbound on Fraser Highway at 140 km/h in a 70 km/h zone on Monday morning.

item.title: Charge approved after gunshot incident on New Westminster’s Columbia Street
item.description: Police in New Westminster say on Monday that two suspects connected to a gunshot incident in New Westminster in January were arrested, and at least one is facing charges.

item.title: Beware of high-quality counterfeit bills, North Vancouver RCMP says
item.description: The North Vancouver RCMP is out with a warning after an increasing number of counterfeit bills have been found in circulation over the last two months.

item.title: Canadians face higher gas and flight costs amid war in the Mideast
item.description: A Simon Fraser University researcher warns of a "global economic catastrophe" as war in the Middle East threatens to raise the price of gas and air travel.

item.title: Extortion cases in Surrey trending downwards, according to police chief
item.description: The chief of the Surrey Police Service (SPS) says the number of extortion-related shootings this year has declined.

item.title: Canadians continue to have unfavorable view of India amid new trade agreements: survey
item.description: It appears that many Canadians remain hesitant about the federal government's effort to rebuild relations with India.
